title: deliverables/index.json and a delivery folder's index.json
description: The deliverables and sub-folders of a delivery folder, with its delivery settings. Every index.json states its own delivery in full; delivery folders are one level deep.

description.description: For people only, never sent to a model: lines joined with a newline, or null for none (the folder).

items.description: The folder's members by bare id, in order, each exactly once.

delivery.description: The kinds of destination; [] means deliberately not delivered (kept in History only).

bundle.description: "zip" sends the folder's deliverables together as one archive; null for none.
